conditions.runtime: The standalone JEM Building mod is installed on both the logical server and participating clients.

change.summary: Add the standalone survival construction hammer and persistent hollow construction placeholders.

modifiers.after: A left-click radial menu selects wall, floor, 1x1 column, hollow sphere, or an open-ended hollow vertical cylinder. Right-click confirms against a block or live air target, with every axis bounded to 256 blocks, then incrementally populates persistent placeholders without forced chunk generation.

Confirmed placeholders are free, while every real block is placed through the held BlockItem and consumes its ordinary survival stack. The clicked placeholder is replaced immediately, and every replaced, occupied or manually broken cell is persisted as settled so region recovery cannot recreate a ghost placeholder there.

modifiers.before: Temporary construction placeholders persisted until manual cancellation or replacement.
modifiers.after: Each temporary construction region stores one seven-Minecraft-day expiry. A coarse server queue expires due regions without per-block polling, incrementally removes only remaining placeholders in loaded chunks, and leaves every real replacement block intact. Optional Jade presentation shows only one current unit: whole Minecraft days with a trailing plus for a positive remainder, then minutes during the final day, then seconds during the final minute.

modifiers.before: The client stored and previewed a selection before server acceptance, selection and confirmation rejection paths were silent, and JEM Compat could route the same right-click to Handcrafted or Building But Better before construction confirmation.
modifiers.after: Construction protocol 4 makes the server the selection authority. The server returns an explicit accepted or rejected SelectionResponse, accepted hammer NBT carries a revision token, the client renders only a confirmed revision-bearing selection, and Confirm must echo the current revision before geometry is accepted. Localized rejection reasons expose invalid hammer, unloaded, distant, air, outside-world, missing, stale and invalid-geometry failures. A confirmed JEM construction selection owns the ordinary right-click before UnifiedHammer. Without a confirmed selection, Handcrafted Hammerable and Building But Better tag behavior remain native.

rationale.purpose: Provide survival builders with persistent material-backed construction cells without a tier ladder, free blocks or private JEM dependencies.
rationale.decision_source: User supplied the Major Building and Quality-of-Life mission and explicitly assigned the standalone construction mod to its own Sandbox branch. Codex selected bounded region work, ordinary saved blocks and native BlockItem filling as implementation details.

introduced.summary: Add JEM Building as an independent Forge 1.20.1 construction mod.

history.summary: Replace the incoherent runtime JAR, which combined stable construction classes with stale unregistered Blueprint outputs, with one clean production artifact built only from the current develop source. The hammer selection, confirmation, persistent region and placeholder lifecycle remain unchanged. The replacement artifact SHA-256 is 174e949f0b1b447816120436d2ecff5c4df8d414f4c237924ff82a781065f8ed.
Keep JEM Building standalone while allowing JEM Compat to promote its builder hammer into native Handcrafted and BBB interactions and retire both legacy player-facing items.
Replace the clicked placeholder immediately and persist completed, occupied or manually broken cells so background and chunk recovery never reconstruct them.
Add a block-cell vertical cylinder whose circular side wall has no top or bottom caps, sharing the existing preview, persistence, filling, cancellation and expiry lifecycle.

Persist one seven-Minecraft-day deadline per region, process only due regions through a coarse server expiry queue without per-block tick scans, and expose the remaining lifetime through optional one-unit Jade presentation.
Give hammer cancellation one explicit owner, render sphere previews from shared block cells, and resolve column height from the cursor ray instead of direct pitch scaling.
Replace face selection with a four-mode radial menu, block-or-air confirmation, look-directed walls, 1x1 columns, hollow spheres, and 256-block bounds.
Add one hammer, three axis-aligned planes, hollow saved placeholders, cancellation and survival material filling.

Require a protocol-4 server acknowledgement and revision before preview or confirmation, expose rejection reasons, and give a confirmed construction selection precedence over the optional Handcrafted and Building But Better hammer adapter.
Archived source paths removed with Create, Immersive Aircraft and their retired integrations

relations: held BlockItem -> native placement and inventory consumption
left-click mode request -> server validation -> SelectionResponse -> revision-bearing hammer NBT -> client preview
right-click -> current revision confirmation -> server geometry validation -> persistent placeholders
confirmed JEM construction selection -> construction confirmation before UnifiedHammer
no confirmed construction selection -> native Handcrafted Hammerable or Building But Better behavior
jem_building:builder_hammer -> Handcrafted Hammerable.onHammer through JEM Compat
impacts.notes: JEM Building remains independently loadable. Protocol 4 changes the network handshake for selection and confirmation, so the exact matching JEM Building artifact is required on client and server. When JEM Compat, Handcrafted and BBB are present, JEM Compat defers only while the hammer has a server-confirmed construction revision and otherwise preserves their registered block behavior.
unresolved: Runtime player acceptance and third-party claim-mod behavior were not exercised because the user prohibited all tests and validation runs.
